label: Noir & Gold
description: Near-black with antique gold on a dark page. Premium and evening-lit — suits unisex salons, barbers and grooming studios, and any brand whose printed identity is already black and gold.
notes:
Tokens only — sections never hardcode colours, they read these as CSS variables.

MATCHED TO A PRINTED IDENTITY, NOT CHOSEN FRESH. This replaced an earlier green theme ('blade-fern') built before the client's business card was seen. The card is black with gold and silver lettering, so the website was the thing that was wrong. When a customer is handed a card in the salon and looks the place up on their phone, the two should obviously be the same business — a site that does not match the card reads as a different shop, or a fake one.

DARK MODE FLIPS THE CONTRAST PROBLEM: on a light theme the gold accent is the hard one to pass, here it is the easiest. Gold primary measures 8.03:1 on the background and 7.39:1 on surface; the lighter gold accent 9.76:1 and 8.99:1; body text 16.92:1; muted 7.13:1; and black-on-gold buttons 8.03:1. All well clear of AA. The trap in the other direction is muted text going too dim — keep it at or above #A39C90.

Both fonts serve weights 400-700 on Google Fonts (checked).
